scenes.description: A person pushing an old sedan uphill on an empty road, straining, low afternoon light, wide shot. Motif plant: motif_hidden_engine_001 — do not reveal the engine running yet.

scenes.shot_intent: Make the resistance physically legible — a felt weight, not an abstract complaint.

required_assets.description: Tired hands rubbing eyes at a kitchen table, muted light.

scenes.description: PLACEHOLDER beat (illustrates EvoLink-authored script filler). A repeating cycle — treadmill, revolving door, or the same commute repeated — visualizing 'chasing the next thing' as a loop rather than a single event.

required_assets.description: Hands working intently on a craft/instrument, focused, warm light, close up.

required_assets.description: motif_hidden_engine_001 (turn): the same car driving smoothly on an open road, golden hour.

scenes.description: PLACEHOLDER beat. Final image: the same car driving away under its own power, open road, before the end-tag fades in over the last seconds of this shot.
scenes.shot_intent: Closing image the end-tag overlay will sit on top of — needs a visually uncluttered final few seconds for the text to read.

required_assets.description: motif_hidden_engine_001 (final payoff): the car driving away under its own power, open road, final seconds visually clean enough for a text overlay.

metadata.tone_rationale: EvoLink's creative call, not user-specified: 'dreamlike' was picked over the other four fixed registers (elegiac/urgent/reverent/wry) because its definition — repeated motifs, non-linear, reflective — is the only one that fits a memory-driven personal-growth monologue built around one recurring visual motif planted and paid off three times. None of the five registers was designed for this content type; flag for override if it reads wrong once footage is in.

motif_hidden_engine_001.continuity_caveat: This is real stock/archival footage, not a custom-shot continuity asset — literal same-vehicle continuity across scene_001/006/011/012 is only achievable if the asset-director's retrieval pulls multiple clips from the same source video/series, or if the user supplies/records one car specifically for this motif. If retrieval returns four unrelated cars, downgrade the ambition from 'same car' continuity to 'same visual language' (similar era, color, framing) rather than failing the beat.
